g.text: The cookie is not marked Secure and may be sent over plain HTTP.
Add the Secure attribute to every cookie set over HTTPS.
SameSite=None without Secure; browsers reject this cookie.
Set SameSite=Lax or Strict unless cross-site delivery is required; SameSite=None requires Secure.
The cookie violates its __Secure-/__Host- prefix rules and browsers will reject it.
__Secure- cookies need Secure; __Host- cookies need Secure, Path=/ and no Domain.
Send `Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains` on every HTTPS response once
The cookie is readable by page scripts (no HttpOnly).
Add HttpOnly to cookies that scripts do not need, especially session identifiers.
Set SameSite=Lax or Strict unless cross-site delivery is required; SameSite=None requires Secure.
